args: set -euo pipefail; APPLE_MAIL_CODEX_ROOT="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT="$APPLE_MAIL_CODEX_ROOT/runtime"; APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME="$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT/apple-mail-tools"; APPLE_MAIL_PROJECT="$PWD/server"; APPLE_MAIL_STAMP="$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/.apple-mail-tools-source.sha256"; APPLE_MAIL_LOCK="$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/libexec/runtime_lock.py"; APPLE_MAIL_PYTHON="$(command -v python3 || true)"; if [ -z "$APPLE_MAIL_PYTHON" ] || [ ! -d "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT" ] || [ -L "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT" ] || [ ! -d "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME" ] || [ -L "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME" ] || [ ! -d "$APPLE_MAIL_PROJECT" ] || [ -L "$APPLE_MAIL_PROJECT" ] || [ ! -f "$APPLE_MAIL_LOCK" ] || [ -L "$APPLE_MAIL_LOCK" ] || [ ! -x "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/bin/apple-mail-mcp" ] || [ ! -x "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/bin/apple-mail-runtime-stamp" ]; then echo "Apple Mail runtime is missing or unsafe; rerun scripts/setup-codex-toolbox.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi; export APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME APPLE_MAIL_PROJECT APPLE_MAIL_STAMP APPLE_MAIL_LOCK APPLE_MAIL_PYTHON; exec "$APPLE_MAIL_PYTHON" "$APPLE_MAIL_LOCK" --mode shared --root "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME_PARENT" -- /bin/zsh -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if ! "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/bin/apple-mail-runtime-stamp" check "$APPLE_MAIL_PROJECT" "$APPLE_MAIL_STAMP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Apple Mail runtime is stale; rerun scripts/setup-codex-toolbox.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$APPLE_MAIL_RUNTIME/bin/apple-mail-mcp"'
